description: Call this tool to draw a word such as PAID or DRAFT across the pages, in a colour and position you choose. Writes a new file; input untouched. Free tier: the PAID and DRAFT presets in their preset colours.

color.description: Hex code such as #1b7f3b, or a name: red, green, blue, black, gray, orange, purple. Pro

font_size.description: Point size. By default the stamp is sized to fit the page width

opacity.description: 0 to 1. Default 0.35 in the centre, 0.85 in a corner

out_path.description: Name for the stamped PDF; it comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

pages.description: Which pages to stamp, e.g. "1" or "2,4-6". Omit for every page

path.description: Name of an uploaded PDF (pdf_upload), or one this server wrote earlier

position.description: Where on the page. Default center, which is drawn on the 45-degree diagonal like a real stamp

text.description: What to stamp. PAID and DRAFT are presets with their own colour; any other text is Pro

name: pdf_stamp
title: Stamp text on a PDF
